act_title: The Government of Union Territories Act, 1963
title: Salaries and allowances of members.―Members of the Legislative Assembly of** [1][the Union
text:
17. Salaries and allowances of members.―Members of the Legislative Assembly of [the Union

territory] shall be entitled to receive such salaries and allowances as may from time to time be determined
by the Legislative Assembly of the Union territory by law and, until provision in that behalf is so made,
